Hi Jamie / team,

Quick note to confirm next week's product demo for Acme. We currently have the 60min slot on Oct 14 at 2:00pm PT on the calendar. Eric (CTO) mentioned he may want to join; Jamie, can you confirm if that was confirmed? If Eric will definitely join, we want to make sure our VP/CTO-level content is present and the right Redwood executive can attend.

If Eric is joining and needs an earlier slot, I can try to move things on my side but I do have a flight on the 14th that morning — possibility of a conflict. If we need to shift, options from our side: Oct 14 at 10:00am PT (Marissa or Vivek can lead if I am in transit), or Oct 15 at 9:00am PT (I can be on deck). Let me know which works for Eric.

Attached a draft agenda and an exec slide pack; happy to tailor further if Eric wants a more CTO-focused run.

Thanks,
